implement_Future_cancel: implement a concrete Future subclass that cancels a pending computation and returns a boolean
implement_Future_result: implement a concrete Future subclass that returns the computation result or raises TimeoutError
implement_Future_add_done_callback: implement a concrete Future subclass that registers a callback invoked when the computation completes
review_Future_traceback: review the Future abstract class traceback method that returns the exception traceback of a computation
implement_Future_exception: implement a concrete Future subclass that returns the exception raised by the computation or None
